title: Hollingshead Cement opens cement terminal in Florida
summary: Hollingshead Cement opens cement terminal in Florida
body_markdown:
**US:** Hollingshead Cement has started operations at a 100,000t terminal at Port Redwing in Tampa, Florida. The bulk cement division of SRM Concrete will use the site to support the supply of cement for its ready-mix concrete operations and other cement customers in the area. The unit will receive cement by ship.


The terminal was developed and is owned by SESCO Cement. Hollingshead Cement will distribute cement through the unit under an agreement with SESCO. The facility includes a wheel-mounted cement ship unloader, storage silos and a mobile conveyor system.
